subject.title: feat(workboard): clarify proof provenance and diagnostics

question: Should Workboard publish `independently_verified` as a caller-declared provenance label, while retaining `done` as manual operator acceptance rather than an independently validated state?
rationale: This is a user-visible and automation-visible meaning change in the Workboard contract; source inspection alone cannot determine whether maintainers want callers to be able to assert that label or want a narrower evidence vocabulary.

options.title: Accept the provenance-only model
options.body: Retain manual acceptance, document that the verification label is caller-declared, and merge after the storage and live-proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Keep only worker-reported provenance
options.body: Remove the independently-verified label and retain diagnostics based on evidence presence and freshness without a stronger caller-declared claim.

options.title: Design an attested verification path first
options.body: Pause this PR until Workboard has an owner-defined mechanism that can substantiate independent verification rather than accept a caller label.

recommendation.title: Accept the provenance-only model
recommendation.body: Retain manual acceptance, document that the verification label is caller-declared, and merge after the storage and live-proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context only establishes this contributor as the person actively carrying the Workboard evidence-semantics proposal; a current-main feature owner could not be verified from the available read-only evidence.
